t: An outdoor Wi-Fi listening device that identifies birds by sound.
steps: Order a Haikubox from the company site.
Ask the network team to allow 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and the vendor cloud.
Pick an outdoor spot with a power outlet.
Plug in the device and connect it to Wi-Fi.
Create an account in the app or on the website.
Remove the Wi-Fi password from the device after setup.
Open the lesson plan for your grade band.
Review the first detections with students.
